findings.evidence:
`pkg/ddl/modify_column.go:251-258` registers `defer func(){ failpoint.InjectCall("getModifyColumnType", args.ModifyColumnType) }()` before checking `err` from `model.GetModifyColumnArgs(job)`.
`pkg/meta/model/job_args.go:62-67` returns zero `T` on decode error; for `T=*ModifyColumnArgs` (see `pkg/meta/model/job_args.go:1774-1776`) this can be `nil`, so `args.ModifyColumnType` can panic.
Parent version (`427b891^`) invoked `failpoint.InjectCall` only after successful args decode and type computation (`pkg/ddl/modify_column.go` in parent around `failpoint.InjectCall("getModifyColumnType", args.ModifyColumnType)`).
findings.fix:
Move the `defer` below the `err` check, or guard it:
- After `if err != nil { ... }`, add `defer failpoint.InjectCall("getModifyColumnType", args.ModifyColumnType)`.
- Or in the deferred func: `if args != nil { failpoint.InjectCall(...) }`.
findings.impact: If a modify-column job’s args cannot be decoded (corrupted job, version incompatibility, etc.), this turns a handled “cancel job and return error” path into a panic. The scheduler recovers panics and re-pends unfinished jobs, so this can devolve into repeated panics and a stuck DDL job instead of a clean cancellation.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master:pkg/ddl/modify_column.go` and the same `defer` before the `err` check is still present around `onModifyColumn` (i.e., not fixed later).
findings.verify: Add/adjust a unit test that constructs a `model.Job` for modify-column with invalid/undecodable `RawArgs` and asserts `onModifyColumn` cancels/returns error without panicking (e.g., wrap call with `require.NotPanics`). Also sanity-check that the `getModifyColumnType` InjectCall still fires for the intended test cases when args decode succeeds.
findings.what: Potential nil-pointer panic in `worker.onModifyColumn`: deferred `failpoint.InjectCall` dereferences `args` even when `GetModifyColumnArgs` returns an error (args can be `nil`).
